common.limitExceeded: There are more records than this screen can show; narrow the filter.
common.actionFailed: The action could not be completed.
common.uncertain: No response from the server; the action may have been applied. Refresh the list and check.
common.conflictBody: The record was updated while you were editing. Load the latest version and apply your change again.
common.reasonTooShort: The reason must be at least {{min}} characters.
common.saveViewBody: Search, filters and view choices are stored under this name.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.subtitle: Accounts based on the Turkish Uniform Chart of Accounts; tree and flat list views.
accounts.deleteBody: Accounts with postings or sub-accounts cannot be deleted; deactivate them instead.
accounts.empty: The chart of accounts is empty
accounts.emptyBody: Add accounts or import them from a CSV/XLSX file.
accounts.systemNote: System account: code, parent and classification cannot be changed.

hints.code: Unique within the company; sub-accounts usually start with the parent code (120.01).
hints.parent: Leave empty for a main account.
hints.postable: Only accounts without sub-accounts can take entry lines.
hints.revaluable: Included in period-end FX revaluation; requires a currency.

integrity.title: Chart of accounts rules
integrity.cycle: An account cannot be moved under itself or one of its sub-accounts.
integrity.nonLeafPostable: An account with sub-accounts cannot be postable ({{count}} sub-accounts).
integrity.hasPostings: An account with postings cannot become a header account.
integrity.parentInactive: Parent account {{code}} is inactive; this account may not be usable.
integrity.parentBecomesHeader: Parent account {{code}} is postable now; it becomes a header account once a sub-account is added.
integrity.parentHasPostings: Parent account {{code}} has postings; the server may refuse adding a sub-account.
integrity.prefix: The code does not start with the parent code {{code}} (may be required by company settings).
integrity.typeDiffers: The account type differs from parent account {{code}}.
integrity.unusualBalance: The normal balance is the opposite of what this account type usually has.

tree.hint: Arrow keys: move · Right/Left: expand/collapse · Enter: details · F2: edit · Insert: sub-account

importWizard.title: Import chart of accounts

steps.file: Choose a CSV or XLSX file; a dry run comes first and changes nothing.
steps.review: Dry run result: fix the failed rows and upload again, or import.

importWizard.fileHelp: CSV (UTF-8) or XLSX, at most 10 MB.
importWizard.tooLarge: The file exceeds the {{mb}} MB limit.
importWizard.fixFirst: Importing is not possible while rows fail. Download the error report, fix the file and upload it again.
importWizard.partialToast: Import finished; {{failed}} rows could not be processed.
importWizard.partialBody: {{failed}} rows were not imported. See the failed rows below or download the error report.

fiscal.title: Fiscal years
fiscal.subtitle: Accounting years, year-end closing and reopening.
fiscal.emptyBody: Create a fiscal year before recording entries.

hints.adjustment: A separate zero-length adjustment period on the last day of the year.
hints.dates: Dates can only change while there are no posted entries.
hints.datesLocked: This year has posted entries; its dates cannot change.

wizard.title: New fiscal year
wizard.body: Creating the year opens 12 periods (optionally a 13th) automatically.
wizard.overlap: The date range overlaps fiscal year {{code}}.

close.title: Close fiscal year {{code}}?
close.body: Closing clears the income statement accounts, carries the result to equity and creates the opening entry of the next year.
close.ack: I understand that closing entries will be created and no entries can be recorded in this year once it is closed.
close.noPreview: The server does not provide a preview. Closing applies these steps:
close.step1: 6xx income statement accounts are transferred to 690 Profit or Loss for the Period.
close.step2: 7xx cost accounts are closed through the related income statement accounts.
close.step3: The result moves to 590 Net Profit / 591 Net Loss for the Period.
close.step4: Balance sheet accounts carry over with the opening entry of the next year.
close.openPeriods: Periods not closed: {{count}}. Closing them before the year-end close is recommended.

reopen.title: Reopen fiscal year {{code}}?
reopen.body: Closing and opening entries are reversed. The reason is written to the audit log.

changed.title: The fiscal year changed elsewhere
changed.body: This fiscal year was updated before you confirmed. Review the latest version and confirm again.

periods.title: Accounting periods
periods.subtitle: Soft close, close or reopen periods with a reason.
periods.yearClosed: This fiscal year is closed; reopen the year before changing periods.

actions.softCloseBody: {{start}} – {{end}}: only authorized users can record entries.
actions.closeBody: {{start}} – {{end}}: no entries can be recorded in a closed period. Draft entries block closing.
actions.reopenBody: {{start}} – {{end}}: the reason is written to the audit log.

blocked.title: The period cannot be closed
blocked.hint: Post, move or delete the draft entries, then try again.

determination.title: Account determination
determination.subtitle: Rules that choose the account used when documents are posted.
determination.dialogBody: The highest-priority rule whose conditions match is chosen; a rule without conditions is the default.
determination.systemNote: System rule: only the account, side and description can change.
determination.noRules: No rule for this event; posting will fail.
determination.deleteBody: This rule of event {{event}} will be deleted.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.help: All conditions must match; separate several alternatives for one value with commas.
conditions.none: No conditions: this rule is used as the default.

errors.duplicate: This key is used more than once.

test.title: Rule test
test.body: Enter an event and context; the account posting would use is shown, nothing is recorded.

determination.moveFailed: The order of {{event}} could not be changed; the previous order was restored. Reason: {{reason}}
determination.moveFailedPartial: The reorder of {{event}} stopped halfway and could not be undone; the current order was reloaded, please check it. Reason: {{reason}}
